title: Hai yeh matam hussain ka matam
body:
hai yeh matam hussain ka matam kyun na chashmein falak bhi ho purnam
1. mustafa quld mein hain sar nange
hain ali ranjo gham mein doobe huwe
aaj hain fatima ke baal khule kyun na roye saron ko peeth ke hum
2. karbala me yeh kaisa mehshar hai
qaak par deen ka muqadar hai
bosagah-e-nabi pa khanjar hai
khoon barsa rahi hai chashm-e-alam
3. dil mein gham karbala ke rehte hain
ashk ankhon se aap behte hain
hum jo hai hussain kehte hain
zakhm dil ka yahi toh hai marham
<<MINI>>
hain yeh maatam . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. teer zaalim ka asghar-e-besheer
roke kehte the hazrat-e-shabbir
kis tarha dard ki mitey tehreer
maa ke dil par jo hogayi hain raqam
<<MINI>>
hain yeh maatam . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. sar aisa bhi kya milega kahin
fikr beton ki mayyaton ki nahi
qaak par binte murtuza ki jabeen
sajda-e-shukr-e-haq me hain paiham
<<MINI>>
hain yeh maatam . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. husn ka jis ke bol wala tha
jo asar martabat mein aala tha
jisko athara saal paala tha
jaa raha hain who soy-e- mulk-e-adam
<<MINI>>
hain yeh maatam . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. paikar-e-pyaas run ko jaata hain
sab ka ehsaan run ko jaata hain
ab woh abbas run ko jaata hain
jis se baaqi tha bibiyon ka bharam
